suggested_requirements.text: The SCE-MI shall provide multiple communication channels between software models on a host workstation and a device under test (DUT) on a verification platform.
The SCE-MI shall provide a service loop function to allow the infrastructure to service communication channels.
The SCE-MI shall provide clock and reset generation and shared clock control using handshake signals with the transactor.
The SCE-MI shall provide a C++ object-oriented interface and a C API for application interaction.
The SCE-MI shall support version discovery, parameter access, initialization, and shutdown.
The SCE-MI shall support message input and output port proxy binding and callback registration.
The SCE-MI shall support rendezvous operations between the software side and the hardware side.
The SCE-MI shall provide error handling mechanisms.
The SCE-MI shall be optimized to avoid communication bottlenecks when interfacing software models to an emulator.
The SCE-MI shall be optimized to be compatible with SystemC.
The SCE-MI shall use message or transaction oriented communication rather than event oriented communication.
The SCE-MI shall allow transactors to freeze controlled time while performing message composition and decomposition operations.
